Metadata.title: CamiloShop — Tech, beauty and urban fashion
Metadata.description: Online store for tech, cosmetics and clothing with an urban style. Portfolio project with sandbox payments.

Common.portfolioNotice: Portfolio project: payments run in sandbox mode and no real money is charged.

Payments.title: Payment
Payments.payHint: Your order is reserved. Complete the payment on {gateway, select, simulated {the simulated gateway} other {Wompi}} before it expires.

SimulatedGateway.back: Back to the order without paying
